g.text: SYNTHETIC example: trajectory and speed error
ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Deterministic surrogate errors, not trained-model predictions. See README for the exact assumptions.
A perfect initial speed on a straight, constant-speed path would give zero error for the last-speed baseline.
